title: Shared content definitions (canonical v2)
description: Section and fragment definitions shared by location.schema.json and service.schema.json. Every definition here mirrors what a template part actually reads; the template is cited on each one. Changing a definition without changing its template is how the v1/v2 fork happened — see ADR-0003.

prose.description: A paragraph of plain prose. Never contains markup or URLs — lvjcb_prose() escapes it, links city mentions, and turns the phone number into a tel: link. Business identity appears only as the {business} and {phone} tokens.

image.description: Read by template-parts/sections/rich-content.php, which resolves 'slug' to a media attachment via lvjcb_get_attachment_id_by_slug().

align.description: 'left' or 'right' places the image beside the prose; 'wide' runs it the full container width.

tableCell.description: Either plain text, or an object naming a service slug that rich-content.php resolves to a URL — so the content file never stores a link.

block.description: An H3 sub-block inside a content section.

contentSection.description: type 'content' -> template-parts/sections/rich-content.php. Must carry at least one of paragraphs, blocks, or table: a section with only a heading renders an empty H2, which is the exact v1 failure mode ADR-0003 exists to prevent.

variant.description: Section background modifier. Omit to let written-page.php alternate automatically.

stepsSection.description: type 'steps' -> template-parts/sections/how-it-works.php, each step passed to components/step-card.php.

ctaSection.description: type 'cta' -> template-parts/sections/cta-banner.php. The CTA label and URL are supplied by the template from business-config.php, never by the content file.

areasSection.description: type 'areas' -> template-parts/sections/service-areas.php. Items name a service area by slug only; city, state, and URL are resolved from business-config.php at render, so a retired area cannot leave a stale link.

servicesSection.description: type 'services' -> template-parts/sections/what-we-buy.php. Tier 3 per ADR-0004: the page chooses placement, subset, and an optional per-entry note; heading, description, icon, and URL all resolve from services.cards in business-config.php at render. Omit 'items' to show every service. Naming a slug that is not in the config is an error, so a retired service cannot leave a dead card behind.

items.description: Optional subset, in display order. Omit for all services.

note.description: Optional page-specific line replacing the service's configured description — the one place a page may speak about a service in its own words.

section.description: Dispatched on 'type' by template-parts/written-page.php. An unrecognised type must fail here: the renderer's default branch would otherwise draw it as a content section without complaint. Tier 1 components (trust strip, vehicles, testimonials, contact, closing CTA) are deliberately absent — they render globally and are not expressible here (ADR-0004).

internalLinks.description: DEPRECATED. No PHP reads this key: internal links are produced at render time by lvjcb_autolink_locations(), by 'areas' sections, and by service-linked table cells. Retained so existing files stay valid; the validator warns. See ADR-0003.
internalLinks.x-deprecated: No renderer consumes internal_links. Links are generated at render time; this block is inert data.
